rationale: Lyc compound ϣⲛ-ϩⲧⲏⲩ = ϣⲛ̄-ϩⲧⲏϥ 'have-pity-of-heart, be compassionate' (Crum). The qualitative/adjectival modifies 'the light' in line 14, characterizing the merciful aspect of the redeeming Light that comes for the soul. Lyc ⲋ for ϩ; -ⲧⲏⲩ for -ⲧⲏϥ shows the dialectal vowel-form.

Substantival qualitative ⲡⲉⲧ- + ⲭⲁⲗⲭ from ⲭⲁⲗⲭ/ϫⲱⲗⲕ̄ 'mingle, twist together' (already in glossary as 'mingle/fashion together'). The expression names the captive soul mingled with the cosmic order — fitting the catechumen-soul about to be redeemed. Distinct from substantival ⲡⲉⲧⲍⲏⲡ 'the hidden one' which has a different cosmological register.

proposed_english: they scourged him / they punished him
rationale: Perfect 3pl + 3sg.m object on ⲉϣⲧ-stem 'scourge, afflict' (cf. accumulated ⲉϣⲧ 'scourge/afflict/torment'). The form ⲉϣⲡϩ shows -ⲡ extension before object suffix. Pairs with ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲣϩ̄ 'they bound him' as standard punitive doublet in the worldly-judicial parable framing this kephalaion.

Lyc ⲡⲉϩ- 'his' + ⲣ̄ⲡⲙⲉⲩⲉ 'remembering, remembrance' (in glossary as ⲡⲣ̄ⲡⲙⲉⲩⲉ 'the remembrance/memory'). In catechumen-prayer context the sense extends to commemorative/memorial prayer made for the bound or departed catechumen — a standard Manichaean ecclesiastical practice.
